base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl wget ca-certificates gnupg xmlstarlet maven
setup_runtime_commands: for i in 1 2 3; do if mvn -B install -DskipTests -U -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.count=3 -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.delay_secs=10; then break; else if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; sleep 10; fi; done

for i in 1 2 3; do if mvn -pl flink-cdc-runtime -am -B dependency:go-offline -U -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.count=3 -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.delay_secs=10; then break; else if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; sleep 10; fi; done
activation_command: export JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/jdk8u412-b08 && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && export MAVEN_HOME=/usr/share/maven && export PATH=$MAVEN_HOME/bin:$PATH

prepare_commands: for i in 1 2 3; do if mvn -B install -DskipTests -U -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.count=3 -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.delay_secs=10; then break; else if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; sleep 10; fi; done

for i in 1 2 3; do if mvn -pl flink-cdc-runtime -am -B dependency:go-offline -U -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.count=3 -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.delay_secs=10; then break; else if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; sleep 10; fi; done
runtime_profile.notes: Java 8 (Temurin JDK 8u412) and Maven 3.8.7 installed. Project uses Maven multi-module structure. Test target is flink-cdc-runtime module. Maven dependencies are pre-cached during image construction with retry logic: (1) 'mvn install -DskipTests -U' builds all modules and installs inter-module SNAPSHOT artifacts to local repo (retries 3x), (2) 'mvn dependency:go-offline' downloads external JARs and POMs while network is available (retries 3x). This ensures inter-module SNAPSHOT dependencies (e.g., flink-cdc-common:3.2-SNAPSHOT) are available before caching external deps. Maven is configured to use Mirror proxy at http://mirror.proxy.hpc:8081/repository/maven-public/ with fallback to Maven Central (mirrorOf=external:* allows fallback). HTTP timeouts configured: connection=30s, request=60s, socket=30s.

notes: Apache Flink CDC project requires Java 8 (JDK 1.8) and Maven 3.x. The fix is in the flink-cdc-runtime module. Git and curl are included in baseline system packages. The test to run is PostTransformOperatorTest#testDataChangeEventTransformWithDuplicateColumns. Maven dependencies are pre-cached during Docker image construction when network is available; tests run offline using cached /root/.m2/repository. Maven is configured to use Mirror proxy at http://mirror.proxy.hpc:8081/repository/maven-public/ with fallback to Maven Central (mirrorOf=external:*). Retry logic added for network resilience: mvn commands retry up to 3 times with 10s delay, wagon retry handler configured with count=3 and delay_secs=10. HTTP timeouts configured for slow connections.
